**Issue #4850 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4850: Patch: `classify --claims` sees a script change to a card's Radiant face, by playing its forced games with the card Radiant too
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

`classify --claims` confirms a script-only change by playing 40 plain games (seeds 1 to 40) with the card forced into both decks, on the branch's build and on the base's, and counting where they diverge (`crates/tools/src/classify.rs:950-975`, `forced_games_diverge`; the games come from `crates/tools/src/golden.rs:394-399`, `record_game`, which builds `CreateGameArgs { seed, decks, handicaps, ..default }` with no deck marks).

In a plain game a card is Radiant only by an in-game upgrade, so those games almost never run a card's Radiant face:

- Core #2 Speciesist (`core-002`): resolved in 36 of the 40 games, **never on its Radiant face**; a Radiant copy exists in 1 game.
- Three other cards sampled the same way: `classic-004` Radiant in 1 of 40, `stinkyscape-094` 1 of 40, `meditative-040` 3 of 40.

So a change to Speciesist's Radiant Cry (`destroy_all`, against the base face's `destroy`) cannot diverge. `checked.scripts` stays empty and the change reads as Internal. `--claims` then asks for no patch fragment, and an honest `--plays core-002` fails with "claims "core-002" plays differently, but its games against the base build play as before (R1370000)". A real card change merges with no patch entry, and the true claim is refused.

The premise is proven by the test. The consequence is by reading (`claims.rs:71-75`, `:86-98`), with high confidence; it was not run end to end against a base build.

### What should happen

- R1365000: "A card plays differently when … its script's code changes".
- R3935001 already treats this class as a defect: "`classify --claims` read the change as playing as before and a fragment could not claim it. This amends that check."
- The fuzz gate closed the same gap for itself in #4161 (`crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs:644-647`: "The plain wave's copies are Radiant only by an in-game upgrade, so this small second batch pins them Radiant").

### How to reproduce

Fails on `main` (3a83bd7): `classify_forced_games_play_the_forced_cards_radiant_face`, in [`crates/tools/tests/audit_tools.rs` at b5a9801](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/b5a9801/crates/tools/tests/audit_tools.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`). It runs `jackioh golden record --seeds 1..40 --force core-002 --out <tmp>`, which is exactly what `record_seeds(1..=FORCED_GAMES, [id], [])` records, folds each game again with `create_game`, `begin_game` and `reduce`, and counts `GameEvent::CardResolved { def_id == "core-002", radiant: Some(true) }`.

```rust
let (games, resolved, resolved_radiant, held_radiant) = forced_games("core-002");
assert_eq!(games, 40);
assert!(resolved > 0, "the control: the forced games play the card");
assert!(resolved_radiant > 0, "none of classify's forced games resolves it Radiant …");
```

Run with `JACKIOH_AUDIT_TMP=<a scratch directory> cargo test -p jackioh-tools --features jackioh-engine/testkit --test audit_tools`.

Output today: `core-002: 40 forced games, resolved in 36, resolved Radiant in 0, a Radiant copy held in 1`.

### Where

CI, deploys or tooling: `crates/tools/src/classify.rs` (`forced_games_diverge`), `crates/tools/src/golden.rs` (`record_game`).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- When the plain forced games show no divergence, record a second batch with the forced cards pinned Radiant (deck marks carried in the recorded `args`, as `GameSetup::radiant` does for the fuzz's Radiant rotation) and count its divergences the same way. Only when the first batch is quiet, so the common case costs what it does now.
- The recorded games' format gains the marks: check `golden check` and the hotseat fixture still fold (`MatchConfig::fold_args` carries `deckMarks` for the AI's matches already, #1697).
- A ruling note amending R1370000 (as R3935001 amended it before), in this issue's block.
- A limit that R1365000 states and this issue does not change: a divergence counts only when it touches the forced card or no card, so a changed trigger that fires during another card's action is attributed to that card. `STEERED_GAMES` covers only the three Walls.
- Latent neighbours seen by reading, to check while there: stage 1 ignores code below a file's first `#[cfg(test)]` in every Rust file, not only card scripts (`catalog.rs:1752`; no engine, cards or AI source has code below one today), and `code_changed` lexes TypeScript with the Rust lexer, so a `//` inside a single-quoted or template string hides the rest of the line (no live case under `apps/web/src/cards/`).

Found by an audit of the project's own gates (`crates/tools`); the reproduction was run and the code read before filing.

## Goal

`classify --claims` misses a change to a card's Radiant face because its 40 plain forced games almost never resolve the card Radiant. When the plain forced batch shows no divergence, `forced_games_diverge` records a second batch of the same seeds with the forced cards pinned Radiant through `deckMarks` and counts its divergences the same way. Done means a Radiant-only script change (e.g. Core #2 Speciesist's Radiant Cry) diverges against the base build, the recorded format carries the marks and still replays, and a new ruling note amending R1370000 records the decision.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/tools/src/golden.rs` | change | `LineArgs` gains `deck_marks`; `GameSpec` gains `deck_marks`; new `radiant_marks` helper; `record_forced`/`record_seeds` gain `radiant: bool`; `RecordArgs` gains `--radiant`; unit test `r4850000_…` |
| `crates/tools/src/classify.rs` | change | `forced_games_diverge` plays the Radiant second batch when quiet (extract shared check as `diverged_in`); doc comments cite R4850000 |
| `crates/tools/src/steer.rs` | change | one line: test call `record_seeds(&seeds, &ids, &ids, &out)` gains `false` |
| `crates/tools/tests/golden.rs` | change | integration test `r4850000_golden_record_radiant_pins_the_forced_cards_and_replays_clean` |
| `spec/rulings/R4850000.md` | new | ruling note (lowest free number in issue #4850's block; no R4850* note exists) |
| `spec/pending/4850.md` | new | §11 paragraph for the ruling |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | `golden record` row documents `[--radiant]` |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `apps/`, `e2e/`; `docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` (frozen snapshot; plain-game lines stay byte-identical); `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/history/`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`, and the texts of `R1365000.md`/`R1370000.md` (amendment pattern, as R3935001 did). 2. In `crates/tools/src/golden.rs`, extend the imports with `DeckMark`, `PlayerId`, `PLAYER_IDS` from `jackioh_engine`.
3. Add the marks field to the recorded format, keeping plain games byte-identical:
   ```rust
   /// R4850000: `deckMarks` pinning deck indices Radiant; absent for a plain game.
   #[serde(rename = "deckMarks", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   deck_marks: Option<PerPlayerOpt<Vec<DeckMark>>>,
   ```
   on `LineArgs`. No replay change is needed: `replay_game` and `text_at` deserialize `game["args"]` into `CreateGameArgs`, which already carries `deckMarks` (R2702000).
4. Add `pub(crate) deck_marks: Option<PerPlayerOpt<Vec<DeckMark>>>` to `GameSpec`, set to `None` in both `spec_for_seed` constructors. Add beside `record_forced`:
   ```rust
   /// R4850000: both seats' marks pinning the first `count` deck indices Radiant — the forced
   /// cards' slots, since `force_into` puts them first. `None` when there is nothing to pin.
   fn radiant_marks(count: usize) -> Option<PerPlayerOpt<Vec<DeckMark>>> {
       if count == 0 { return None; }
       let mut marks = PerPlayerOpt::default();
       for player in PLAYER_IDS {
           *marks.slot(player) = Some(
               (0..count).map(|index| DeckMark { index, radiant: true, upgrades: 0 }).collect(),
           );
       }
       Some(marks)
   }
   ```
5. Thread the flag through: `record_forced(k, forced, steer, radiant: bool)` sets `spec.deck_marks = radiant_marks(forced.len())` when `radiant`, after the `force_into` loop. `record_game` copies `spec.deck_marks` into both `CreateGameArgs.deck_marks` (clone, as `decks` does) and `LineArgs.deck_marks` (move). `record_seeds(seeds, force, steer, radiant, out)` passes it through.    ```rust
   /// Pin the forced cards Radiant in every recorded game (R4850000).
   #[arg(long)]
   radiant: bool,
   ```
   and pass `args.radiant` in `run_record`. Update the `steer.rs` test call site with `false`.

Pin all forced indices (subject plus steered actors): an actor the diff did not change replays identically on both builds, so it cannot explain a divergence. Update the doc comments on `forced_games_diverge`, `forced_diverge`, and the module's stage-2 paragraph to cite R4850000. Leave the unforced replay (`record_seeds(&seeds, &[], &[], …)`) on `false`.
7. Write `spec/rulings/R4850000.md` with front matter `id: R4850000`, a title in R3935001's style, `cards: "§9.4, R1365000, R1370000, R3935001; C #2"`, `proven_in` listing `crates/tools/src/golden.rs` and `crates/tools/tests/golden.rs`. Body: the plain batch resolves Radiant only by in-game upgrade; a quiet batch is replayed on the same seeds with the forced indices pinned Radiant (R2702000); divergences count as before (steered actors as R3935001); groups pin all forced indices; `golden record --radiant`; `args` gains `deckMarks`, absent for plain games. Write `spec/pending/4850.md` with the one `**[[R4850000]] … (issue #4850, 2026-11-25)**: …` paragraph.
8. Add the `r4850000` unit test in `golden.rs`'s `tests` module (copy the fold loop in `steer.rs`'s `steered_plays`): `record_seeds(&(1..=40).collect(), &["core-002"], &[], true, &out)`; assert 40 lines; assert each line's `args` deserializes to `CreateGameArgs` whose `deck_marks` pins index 0 Radiant for both seats; assert each line replays via `replay_game`; fold each game with `create_game`/`begin_game`/`reduce` over its recorded actions, counting `GameEvent::CardResolved { def_id: "core-002", radiant: Some(true) }`; assert `games == 40`, `resolved > 0`, `resolved_radiant > 0`. Do not assert the plain batch resolves Radiant zero times (brittle control).
9. Add the integration test in `crates/tools/tests/golden.rs`, following the file's `record` helper pattern: `golden record --seeds 1..5 --force core-055,core-024 --radiant --out`; assert 5 lines each containing `deckMarks`; assert `golden check --file` succeeds with `5 of 5 games replayed identically`.
10. Update the `golden record` row in `crates/tools/README.md` with `[--radiant]`.
11. Verify-only latent neighbours from the issue (no fixes in this diff): confirm no `crates/engine/src`, `crates/cards/src`, `crates/ai/src` file holds code below its first `#[cfg(test)]`, and no live `//`-inside-single-quoted-or-template-string case under `apps/web/src/cards/` fools the lexer. A live case becomes a separate issue, not a wider diff.
12. Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r4850000`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test golden`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools classify`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools steer`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Tests

- `crates/tools/src/golden.rs`, `fn r4850000_a_radiant_batch_pins_the_forced_cards_and_resolves_them_radiant`: 40 radiant games forcing `core-002`; asserts marks pin index 0 Radiant both seats, all replay via `replay_game`, and the fold resolves `core-002` Radiant at least once. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r4850000`.
- `crates/tools/tests/golden.rs`, `fn r4850000_golden_record_radiant_pins_the_forced_cards_and_replays_clean`: CLI `--radiant` record carries `deckMarks` and `golden check` replays 5 of 5. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test golden`.
- Existing suites guard the refactor: `cargo test -p jackioh-tools classify`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools steer`, plus `cargo jackioh spec check` for the ruling/tests linkage.

## Done when

- [ ] Quiet plain batch triggers a same-seed Radiant batch; divergences counted identically; common-case cost unchanged.
- [ ] `r4850000` unit and integration tests pass; existing `classify`, `steer`, `golden` tests pass.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
- [ ] `spec/rulings/R4850000.md` and `spec/pending/4850.md` exist; no other spec file touched.
- [ ] Latent-neighbour checks run; any live case filed separately, not fixed here.

## Risks

- Replay compatibility: old files lack `deckMarks` and still parse (`CreateGameArgs.deck_marks` defaults); plain new lines are byte-identical (`skip_serializing_if`). The parent build is recent enough to know `deckMarks` (R2702000); proved by the integration test.
- Determinism: same seeds mean same decks, streams, and policies; marks are positional and sorted, so the Radiant batch is bit-stable like the plain one.
- Hidden information: marks are setup over public deck lists, applied before the shuffle; both builds replay the same file, so hashes stay comparable.
- Cost: the second 40-game batch runs only after a quiet first batch, including quiet R4145000 groups.

## Open questions

None. No person-only step: all files are editable by the bot, no secret or dashboard setting is involved.
````
